description: Installs a navigation script (the `jsUserScripts` field) in the remote authoring browser, not on this machine, so it runs before each page load, as it does at verification. Reports whether it ran and what it threw. With `navigateUrl`, navigates there and removes the script after reading the result, unless `keep` is true. Without `navigateUrl`, the script stays installed for later navigations until a call with `navigateUrl` removes it. With `keep: true`, the script stays installed for every later navigation in this session, replaces any earlier kept script, and `create_provider_version_from_capture` publishes it as `jsUserScripts` unless that call passes its own. See how_it_works({ topic: "user-script" }).

keep.description: Keep the script installed for every later navigation in this session and use it as the published navigation script.

name: test_user_script
